caption: The drawing features a long, loose-fitting garment with a straight cut, extending to about knee length. It has full, rounded sleeves that gather at the wrists, closed with cuffs that are fastened by buttons. The neckline is high and upright, with a small stand collar that also fastens with a button at the front. Down the center front of the garment, starting from the collar and extending partway down the chest, is a vertical placket decorated with a symmetrical arrangement of floral embroidery or ornamental patterns on either side of the buttoned opening. The garment is rendered in fine, light gray or black lines on a beige background, giving an uncluttered appearance with no shading or color fill. The side seams near the bottom are illustrated with small triangular gussets that add detail to the construction, and both the cuffs and collar are outlined with clear stitching lines. The composition is centered on the page and depicts the garment as if laid flat, showing only the front side.
title: Man's Shirt
